caption: The drawing features a circular object with a raised border containing evenly spaced vertical lines. Inside the circle, there is a symmetrical pattern resembling a stylized plant with multiple elongated, pointed leaves radiating from a central point. The leaves display alternating shades of brown, beige, and dark green, with detailed vein-like markings. At the base of the plant is a textured, dome-shaped mound patterned with a grid of diamond shapes in various shades of brown. The circle is centrally placed on a plain, cream-colored background. Below this main image, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" appears in uppercase, red-brown letters. Beneath the name, there is a simple, thin outline drawing of a shape that resembles a handle attached to a flat base, rendered in black ink.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
